description: Vehicle, component, and identifier reference datasets published by benthic.io using signed BDP manifests and PostgREST APIs.
license: Varies by member; see each dataset manifest.
purpose: Parts provides a growing collection of vehicle and component datasets for identifying parts, vehicles, manufacturers, and technical reference data. The NHTSA vPIC dataset is the first member and combines the official decoder with a synchronized reference layer.
title: Parts
